title: Separate User Settings from Owner System Administration
context: Previously, /ayarlar was restricted strictly to OWNER users and contained all system controls, while regular logged-in users had no settings page. Phase 1.5 mandates clear separation: /ayarlar for all users' personal preferences and /admin for owner control.
decision: Establish /ayarlar as universal user settings (Profile, Security, Notification preferences, Telegram, Email, Quiet Hours, Appearance) and /admin as Owner Control Center (Dashboard, Users, Catalog, Integrations, Operations, System).
consequences: Standard users gain a dedicated personal settings portal
System administration is isolated under server-side protected /admin route
SettingsCenter monolith is decomposed into focused domain panels
risks: Care must be taken to ensure no admin endpoints leak into /ayarlar or vice versa.
evidence: src/app/ayarlar/page.tsx line 25 previously restricted non-owners with 403
